name: Mokpo-si

routes.outcome: Official K-GeoP landing page loaded and identifies the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport national land-information service.
Official public map viewer loaded. Visible workflow includes 일필지정보 (one-parcel information), map selection, and land/building information.
Current viewer JavaScript was inspected. It defines an anonymous WFS GetFeature request path with outputFormat application/json and supports geometry-intersects/CQL requests.
Current viewer JavaScript confirms one-parcel lookup calls and PNU-based parcel identity handling; owner and other unsafe detail fields were not requested.
Configured public WFS host from current viewer configuration was attempted; DNS resolution failed in this environment (curl error 6). No response, feature type, schema, CRS, or geometry was obtained.

Official Mokpo page documents individual land-price lookup by 읍·면, parcel, and lot number and explains its land-related administrative use. This is local procedure evidence, not proof of a public geometry API.
Official Mokpo civil-services page lists land-register and land-use-plan certificates among public certificate services; no geometry endpoint was exposed.
Official LX page provides general cadastral spatial-information service context; treated as national-agency prose, separate from Mokpo-specific evidence.

localCustodianAssessment: K-GeoP is the national public land-information/cadastral viewer. Mokpo’s official pages specifically document parcel/lot-number land-price lookup and land-register certificate procedures. No separate Mokpo municipal parcel map/API was evidenced; national viewer evidence and local procedure evidence are kept distinct.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identity if independently exposed

qualification.reason: Official public viewer and Mokpo land-information procedure are evidenced, but no anonymous parcel geometry response, usable schema/CRS, or safe native parcel identity was verified.
